title: fisk-ai session store v1 meta record

version.description: On-disk payload schema version. Fold rejects a snapshot written by a newer version.

prompt.description: The initial user prompt, from which the first message is rebuilt.

interactive.description: Marks a chat (--chat) run so a resume reopens the input bar. Absent on a one-shot or batch checkpoint run.

conversation_token.description: The handle the caller holds for this conversation, recorded so a lost one can be recovered. A credential: reading it needs the store access that already grants writing this journal. Absent for a run nobody was handed one for.

caller.description: What the channel knew about who asked for this run, as the caller's own unverified claim. Absent where it knew nothing.
